=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:371-414 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The placeholder loop in `collect_prompt_placeholders` uses `${!placeholder_name}` indirect expansion, which raises "bad substitution" for names that are not valid Bash variable names.
  WHY: A "bad substitution" error would crash the whole prompt-rendering script. Severity was not stated by the source, so medium is a placeholder. Two other reviewers (minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) examined the empty-name case and found the guard at scripts/render_prompt.sh:390 skips it, but they did not address names with illegal characters.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:389 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `placeholder_env_name_is_credential_like` relies on a denylist of variable-name patterns that is not exhaustive.
  WHY: An attacker-controlled placeholder name could match a sensitive environment variable that the denylist misses, leaking a runner secret into the model prompt. The source labelled this SEVERITY: MAJOR, which is mapped here to high.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:1415-1426 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `except Exception` branch in main() prints `str(exc)` in full with no length cap in the ERROR line.
  WHY: A multi-KB exception message would produce an oversized single log line in workflow logs that the log-analysis pipeline later parses. The source labelled this SEVERITY: NIT, which is mapped here to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
